title: OGK Kabuto Exceed Apex TC-2

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Tailored for classic roadsters and urban cruising, the Ogk Kabuto Exceed Apex TC-2 is engineered for warm-weather riding with featherweight crown comfort. Featuring a Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) architecture at a featherweight 1115g, it combines progressive kinetic energy dissipation across DOT, ECE 22.05 certifications with an acoustically tuned ~98 dB aero profile. The interior features a plush, moisture-wicking crown liner shaped for Intermediate Oval head shapes, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for effortless warm-weather riding.

product_details.description: Premium jet helmet with IR-cut shield and large eye port.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for open-face fit; may feel tight on larger head sizes due to Exceed Apex shell geometry.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Ogk OGK Kabuto Exceed Apex TC-2: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Ogk's Open Face lineup, the OGK Kabuto Exceed Apex TC-2 brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Ogk Kabuto Exceed Apex TC-2 represents Ogk's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~98 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) Open Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Ogk Kabuto Exceed Apex TC-2 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
